title: Potted Plant 02 (lite)
author: Rico Cilliers
description: A light version of Potted Plant 02 for phones and crowded scenes: 7,953 triangles instead of 69,806, textures at most 1024px, 1.08 MB instead of 2.63 MB. Simplified with meshoptimizer (error 0.016) by ingestion/lite/lite.mjs; same look from a few metres. Credits and license as the original.

made.tool: gltf-transform 4.5.1 + meshoptimizer 1.3.0 simplify; sharp texture resize
